abilities.name: Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay is dynamic: hold+13 frames (base 13 at minimum hold). Hold frames are also dynamic: actual cancel frame = hold + base-offset; variant frames below record the base-offset slice values (minimum hold). C4 suppresses Hold cooldown for 2 uses or 6s after Q cast.

Heal authored 2026-07-12 as an onCast(skill) heal-over-time on the ability with target 'active' and duration:12 — Dori Alcazarzaray's Exactitude shape (periodic active-character heal window with no spawned entity; the schema has no non-summon tick-interval field, so the 2s cadence is documented here + surfaced via caveat rather than encoded). gcsim skill.go startSkillHealing → Core.Player.Heal(Target: Core.Player.Active()), Src = skillHpRegen[TalentLvlSkill]*MaxHP + skillHpFlat[TalentLvlSkill]. TL10 (index 9, chevreuse_gen.go): skillHpRegen[9]=0.048 → scaling 4.8% Max HP; skillHpFlat[9]=564.98486 → flat 564.985 (sidecar 'HP Regeneration Over Time' col 10 = '4.80% Max HP+565'). Value authored is per-tick — 6 ticks over the 12s window (skillHealInterval=120f=2s; first tick at 2s after CDStart via Tasks.Add(startSkillHealing, skillHealInterval); heal-status skillDur = 12*60+1f so the final tick lands on expiry). Heal fires on BOTH skillPress (skillHeal(skillPressCDStart=18)) and skillHold (skillHeal(cdStart=hold+13)) — not Hold-only. C4 retrigger refreshes the same skillHealKey status (durationType left default; single 12s window models the C0 canonical case).
Arkhe: Ousia 'Surging Blade' (10s ICD) — deliberately unmodelled: gcsim skill.go arkhe gives the attack Durability 0, so it reaches no gauge, and its damage magnitude is out of scope. Not work.

Overcharged Ball (2026-09-15): gcsim overchargedBallEventSub sets overChargedBall = true on EVERY OnOverload against an enemy (no actor check, a bool so max 1, no expiry), and skillHold spends it and queues a4 at cdStart. Authored as gainStacks overchargedBall (onReaction overloaded, source team, max 1; team-sourced grants accrue rotation-wide, so a teammate's Overload while Chevreuse is off field counts) + consumeStacks on the hE cast. Gains → snapshot → consumes, so A4's stacks gate on the same cast reads the ball before it is spent. The Overcharged shot's own hit (ICDTagNone, Pyro 25) lands on the same frame as the ordinary Hold shot's, so no separate application list is needed.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The blank after the E pill. The heal IS authored (`onCast`, target active, duration 12) but no non-summon heal reaches any lane, so her skill draws as an instant with a 15s tail and no 12s span or tick marks — while summon-hosted healers on the same screen (Bennett, Xilonen) do get marks. Rewritten to point at the missing window rather than at the mechanic, so the reader knows it is our rendering that is short. Category: expected-but-absent.
abilities.description:
Chevreuse quickly shoulders her musket and fires at her opponent(s), dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
For a short duration after Chevreuse fires a shot, she will continuously restore HP to your active character on the field. The amount healed is based on her Max HP.
Hold to fire in a different fashion.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode, locking a target in her sights to fire a precise interdiction shot. If Chevreuse has an Overcharged Ball, then she will fire the Overcharged Ball instead, dealing greater Pyro DMG in a larger area.
Chevreuse gains 1 Overcharged Ball every time a nearby character in the party triggers an Overloaded reaction, and can have up to 1 Overcharged Ball at a time.

Arkhe: Ousia
Periodically, after Chevreuse's Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire hits, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Ring of Bursting Grenades
abilities.description:
Chevreuse fires an explosive grenade at opponents with her musket, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. After the projectile hits, it will split into many secondary explosive shells.
The secondary explosive shells will burst after a short interval, dealing Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics
_curatorNotes: Party composition gate (2026-09-15, essential-characters T0): gcsim asc.go a1 sets onlyPyroElectro = count[Pyro] > 0 && count[Electro] > 0 && Pyro+Electro == len(chars), and subscribes nothing otherwise. Expressed as teamElementCount, which counts NON-HOLDER members: Chevreuse is Pyro, so 'at least one Pyro' is her; the gate is 'no teammate outside Pyro/Electro' AND 'at least one Electro teammate'. Before this the shred drew in any Overloading team.
source: 'team' — 'After a character triggers the Overloaded reaction' (gcsim subscribes to every OnEnemyDamage carrying AttackTagOverloadDamage, no actor check).
passives.description:
When all party members are Pyro and Electro characters and there is at least one Pyro and one Electro character each in the party:
Chevreuse grants "Coordinated Tactics" to nearby party members: After a character triggers the Overloaded reaction, the Pyro and Electro RES of the opponent(s) affected by this Overloaded reaction will be decreased by 40% for 6s.
The "Coordinated Tactics" effect will be removed when the Elemental Types of the characters in the party do not meet the basic requirements for the Ascension Talent.

passives.name: Vertical Force Coordination
_curatorNotes: Authored 2026-09-15 (essential-characters T0; was a value-less manual skeleton). gcsim asc.go a4: ATK% = min(MaxHP/1000 × 1%, 40%) for 30s to every Pyro AND Electro party member, queued at the Overcharged Hold shot's cdStart. Value: BuffValue scaling hp, ratio 0.1 (1% per 1,000 HP is 0.1 percentage points per 100 HP), cap 40.

Gate: stacks overchargedBall >= 1 on the hE cast (the ball is granted on the skill; see its notes). The receiver is element-filtered and no Condition names a receiver's element, so it is two mutually exclusive effects on the team's composition: target team when no teammate is outside Pyro/Electro (then every member qualifies — exact), else target self (Chevreuse is Pyro). ⚠️ In a mixed team the self arm UNDER-claims — a Pyro/Electro teammate beside a non-Pyro/Electro one also gets the buff in game. Different pools (team vs self), so the stat-dedupe trap does not apply.
Timing: the bar opens at the cast; in game it lands at cdStart (hold + 13f), ~0.2s later.
passives.description: After Chevreuse fires an Overcharged Ball using Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, nearby Pyro and Electro characters in the party gain 1% increased ATK for every 1,000 Max HP Chevreuse has for 30s. ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.

constellations.name: Stable Front Line's Resolve
_curatorNotes: Authored 2026-09-15 (essential-characters T0). gcsim cons.go c1: on OnOverload, skip Chevreuse's own, skip off-field actors, 10s ICD, +6 Energy to the actor; returns early unless onlyPyroElectro (A1's composition gate, carried here). source 'active' is the on-field half; ⚠️ 'not Chevreuse herself' has no Condition, so her own on-field Overloads are counted too. Energy has no planner surface; this is the Team Builder's energy facet.
constellations.description:
When the active character with the "Coordinated Tactics" status (not including Chevreuse herself) triggers the Overloaded reaction, they will recover 6 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics."

constellations.name: Sniper Induced Explosion
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill with filter.damageTag:'skillHold' 2026-05-09 (G primitive). gcsim c2() AttackCBFunc is only passed to skillHold's QueueAttack, not skillPress; the Hold variant on the parent skill carries the default skillHold tag (auto-derived from input:['hE']). 10s procCooldown matches the gcsim ICD. Fires 2 chain explosions per proc — authored as a single damage effect with 240% combined scaling would over-compress; 120% per explosion is the canonical per-instance value with the actual 2× multiplicity captured implicitly in the proc semantic.
constellations.description: After Holding Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals Pyro DMG equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

_curatorNotes: Heal effect trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator. Probable trigger: timer — gcsim fires c6TeamHeal() once, exactly 12s after skill-heal activates (c6HealQueued guard prevents duplicates). Single activation per skill cast. Applies to all party members (target: 'team' appears correct). gcsim: c6TeamHeal() in cons.go.

DMG bonus effects (electroDmgBonus + pyroDmgBonus) trigger: 'manual' inherited from generator. Probable trigger: per-heal-tick from Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire (gcsim calls c6() from startSkillHealing every 2s). Each call adds an independent 8s stack; max 3 stacks per character tracked by c6StackCounts[]. target: 'self' appears incorrect — gcsim applies to the character currently being healed (active character). Reviewer to fix target and trigger.

After 12s of the healing effect from Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, all nearby party members recover HP equivalent to 10% of Chevreuse's Max HP once.
